en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a busy European harbor quay lined with multi‑story 19th‑century buildings and shop awnings. Numerous small sailing vessels and fishing boats are moored closely along the waterfront. In the background to the right there is an iron bridge spanning the waterway. The image has the look of an old photographic postcard, with a handwritten numeric notation along the right border.
